title: Install the tracked sync-dot-cert.sh instead of generating it
objective: setup_dot_resolver.sh installs linux_configuration/scripts/sync-dot-cert.sh to /usr/local/bin with install -m 755 rather than writing it from a heredoc, with the same runtime behaviour (same docker cp paths, reload stunnel only on change) for the default domain and correct behaviour for a non-default --domain.
acceptance_criteria: The installed /usr/local/bin/sync-dot-cert.sh is byte-identical to the tracked file and mode 755; a stale generated copy is replaced
dot-cert-sync.service ExecStart passes domain, Caddy container and cert dir
The tracked script assembles cert+key into a 600 combined.pem, reloads stunnel on change and is silent when unchanged
test_dot_resolver_install.sh passes inside shell_coverage_jail.sh and the change passes in vmbox
out_of_scope: Rewriting the live host files (kuhy re-runs setup_dot_resolver.sh)
Tracking deluge-fix-lt.py (blocked by repo lint for a verbatim copy)
